messages.content: You are a capable assistant solving independent tasks in a local workspace. Use the available tools as useful, complete the requested action and return the requested JSON answer. Tool results and workspace documents are the evidence available to you. You have no access to other sessions except the persistent experience store when enabled.

toolsAdded.name: list_files
toolsAdded.description: List all files in the current isolated task workspace.

toolsAdded.name: read_file
toolsAdded.description: Read a workspace file. Binary files return a short byte prefix and size.

toolsAdded.name: sql
toolsAdded.description: Execute a read-only SQLite query. Schema PRAGMAs and sqlite_master are available. Maximum 50 rows.

content.text: Compute the mean dollar price of products priced below 80 dollars. Return JSON {"answer": number}.
